projects.name: Bandhan
projects.description: A community events platform that helps people find a cause, organise local gatherings and take part in something good.
projects.alt: Bandhan website homepage with volunteering information
features: Browse upcoming events by cause and search by location or title.
Create and manage events with photos, dates and locations.
Sign in with Google or email, and keep joined events in one place.
Switch between light and dark themes with a saved preference.
projects.overview: Bandhan is built around small, practical ways to help a community. Visitors can explore local events across causes such as plantation, education, food and health. Members can organise gatherings, join events and manage their own contributions.

challenges.title: Authentication across two services
challenges.text: The Next.js client connects to a separate Express API. A same-origin proxy keeps client requests and session cookies consistent, while the API checks sessions and event ownership.

challenges.title: Clear event rules
challenges.text: Event dates must be in the future, repeat joins should not create extra participation records, and organisers should only manage their own events. Validation and ownership checks support these rules.

challenges.title: Useful feedback at every step
challenges.text: Uploads, empty event lists and slow API responses need understandable feedback. The interface includes loading skeletons, image fallbacks, retries and empty states.

future: Explore event reminders and calendar integration.
Add organiser moderation and reporting tools.
Improve event discovery with an optional map view.

projects.name: BazarDor
projects.description: A Bengali market-price tracker for browsing everyday products and comparing prices across markets in Bangladesh.
projects.alt: BazarDor website showing daily prices and product cards
features: Browse 33 everyday products across eight categories.
See daily price increases and decreases at a glance.
Compare minimum, maximum and average market prices when signed in.
Browse categories, sort prices and manage account information.
projects.overview: BazarDor brings daily market information into a Bengali interface. It organises essential products into familiar categories and highlights price changes. Signed-in visitors can look more closely at market-level prices to make informed comparisons.

challenges.title: Bengali prices, numeric sorting
challenges.text: Prices are displayed in Bengali numerals, while category sorting must still compare numeric values correctly. Keeping display formatting separate from the numeric values makes this possible.

challenges.title: Reliable external data
challenges.text: The project uses an assignment API with fallback between two hosts. Its data layer caches responses for five minutes to balance page speed and freshness.

challenges.title: Protected price details
challenges.text: Detailed market comparisons are available to signed-in visitors. BetterAuth handles sessions, with account and profile pages connected to Neon Postgres.

future: Explore price-history charts and longer-term trends.
Add a personal list of frequently purchased products.

projects.name: FitLog
projects.description: A workout companion for exploring exercises, building a daily plan and keeping favourite workouts close at hand.
projects.alt: FitLog website on a mobile viewport showing workout planning and its exercise library
features: Explore a library of twelve exercises and dedicated workout details.
Build a daily plan with up to five lifts.
Save exercises for later and sort by duration, calories or rating.
Track planned exercises, time and calories, with saved local state.
projects.overview: FitLog keeps workout planning focused. Each exercise has its own details page with equipment, difficulty, sets, reps and instructions. Visitors can create a daily plan, bookmark exercises, mark work as done and return without losing their saved selections.

challenges.title: One plan, several views
challenges.text: The workout library, saved list, navbar and daily metrics share changing state. React Context connects these views so additions and removals stay consistent.

challenges.title: Persistence in the browser
challenges.text: Plans and bookmarks survive reloads through localStorage. The project combines local persistence with a client-side interface built on Next.js.

challenges.title: Small, clear constraints
challenges.text: A daily plan allows up to five exercises. Buttons enforce the limit and toast messages explain actions, while sorting and live totals help visitors understand their plan.

future: Explore a workout-history view and progress charts.
Add custom exercises and editable training plans.
Consider optional account-based sync between devices.
